article.title: “The Chiefs Now in This City”
article.excerpt: Virginia, the largest British colony, had nearly 350,000 people in 1763, but the capital, Williamsburg, had no more than 2,000 residents, black and white. The largest urban center in Virginia was actually Norfolk, another port at the intersection of key trade networks.
